posts.en:
A small problem every Korean tutor knows: the student nods in the lesson, and a week later nothing has been reviewed.

I'm a Korean teacher too (about 100 students, 1,700+ hours, mostly Europe and the US), and I built a tool for exactly this. It's on my site CheesePotato:

• Homework in two taps: a course lesson (401 to choose from), a word session (how many times), a grammar drill
• Set each student's level, no level test needed
• Progress report: students × homework table, CSV export, printable report per student
• "Students to check today": overdue, inactive for 3 days, or just finished
• Students join by link or one QR scan

Free for teachers, always. Students in your class get Pro free. Lessons, schedule and payments stay on your own platform: the class tool is only for homework and review.

If you'd like to try it, email me the address you sign in with and I'll open a teacher account.

• 숙제 두 번 눌러서: 코스 레슨(401개 중), 단어 세션(몇 번), 문법 바꿔 쓰기

• 링크나 QR 한 번으로 학생이 들어옴

선생님은 늘 무료, 반 학생은 Pro 무료. 수업 · 일정 · 결제는 쓰시는 플랫폼 그대로이고, 반은 숙제 · 복습용이에요.

Korean teachers: you can use my workbooks as printable class material.

They're PDF workbooks with answer keys: Hangul, particles, TOPIK II vocabulary and writing. Print for your own class (A4 or B5), mark with the key, send the QR practice link to students.
